def clean_channel_name(channel_name):
    clean_name = channel_name.strip()
    clean_name = clean_name.rstrip(".")

    return clean_name


rename_map_open = {
    original_name: clean_channel_name(original_name)
    for original_name in raw_open.ch_names
}

rename_map_closed = {
    original_name: clean_channel_name(original_name)
    for original_name in raw_closed.ch_names
}

print("\nProposed names:")
print(rename_map_open)

4. Estimate Welch PSD¶

In [65]:
tmin, tmax = 5, 55
sfreq = raw_open_clean.info["sfreq"]


n_per_seg = int(4 * sfreq)
n_overlap = n_per_seg // 2
n_fft = 1024


posterior_channels = ["Pz", "P3", "P4", "P7", "P8", "O1", "Oz", "O2"]

def calculate_psd(raw, channel_names):
    segment = raw.copy().crop(tmin=tmin, tmax=tmax)
    data = segment.get_data(picks=channel_names)

    freqs, psd = welch(
        data,
        fs=sfreq,
        window="hann",
        nperseg=n_per_seg,
        noverlap=n_overlap,
        nfft=n_fft,
        axis=-1
    )

    return freqs, psd


freqs, psd_open_oz = calculate_psd(raw_open_clean, ["Oz"])
_, psd_closed_oz = calculate_psd(raw_closed_clean, ["Oz"])


freqs, psd_open_post = calculate_psd(
    raw_open_clean, posterior_channels
)
_, psd_closed_post = calculate_psd(
    raw_closed_clean, posterior_channels
)

psd_open_post_mean = psd_open_post.mean(axis=0)
psd_closed_post_mean = psd_closed_post.mean(axis=0)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4.5))

axes[0].plot(freqs, psd_open_oz[0], label="Eyes Open")
axes[0].plot(freqs, psd_closed_oz[0], label="Eyes Closed")
axes[0].set_title("Welch PSD — Oz")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Frequency (Hz)")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Power spectral density (V²/Hz)")
axes[0].set_xlim(1, 45)
axes[0].legend()
axes[0].grid(alpha=0.25)

axes[1].plot(freqs, psd_open_post_mean, label="Eyes Open")
axes[1].plot(freqs, psd_closed_post_mean, label="Eyes Closed")
axes[1].set_title("Welch PSD — Posterior-channel Average")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Frequency (Hz)")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Power spectral density (V²/Hz)")
axes[1].set_xlim(1, 45)
axes[1].legend()
axes[1].grid(alpha=0.25)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

5. Compute Spectral Features¶

In [66]:
bands = {
    "delta": (1, 4),
    "theta": (4, 8),
    "alpha": (8, 13),
    "beta": (13, 30)
}

def spectral_features(raw, condition):
    segment = raw.copy().crop(tmin=5, tmax=55)
    data = segment.get_data()
    ch_names = segment.ch_names
    rows = []

    for i, channel in enumerate(ch_names):
        freqs, psd = welch(
            data[i],
            fs=sfreq,
            window="hann",
            nperseg=n_per_seg,
            noverlap=n_overlap,
            nfft=n_fft
        )

        band_power = {}
        for band, (low, high) in bands.items():
            mask = (freqs >= low) & (freqs < high)
            band_power[band] = trapezoid(psd[mask], freqs[mask])

        total_power = sum(band_power.values())
        rel_alpha = (
            band_power["alpha"] / total_power
            if total_power > 0 else np.nan
        )

        alpha_mask = (freqs >= 8) & (freqs <= 13)
        alpha_freqs = freqs[alpha_mask]
        alpha_psd = psd[alpha_mask]

        alpha_peak_freq = (
            alpha_freqs[np.argmax(alpha_psd)]
            if len(alpha_psd) else np.nan
        )

        rows.append({
            "condition": condition,
            "channel": channel,
            "delta": band_power["delta"],
            "theta": band_power["theta"],
            "alpha": band_power["alpha"],
            "beta": band_power["beta"],
            "rel_alpha": rel_alpha,
            "alpha_peak_freq": alpha_peak_freq
        })

    return rows

rows = []
rows.extend(spectral_features(raw_open_clean, "Eyes Open"))
rows.extend(spectral_features(raw_closed_clean, "Eyes Closed"))

results_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

print(results_df.head())

In [73]:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import spectrogram

sfreq = raw_open_avg.info["sfreq"]

def get_spectrogram(raw):
    segment = raw.copy().crop(tmin=5, tmax=55)
    signal = segment.get_data(picks=["Oz"])[0]

    freqs, times, power = spectrogram(
        signal,
        fs=sfreq,
        window="hann",
        nperseg=int(2 * sfreq),
        noverlap=int(1.5 * sfreq),
        nfft=512,
        scaling="density",
        mode="psd"
    )

    return freqs, times + 5, 10 * np.log10(power + 1e-20)

freqs_open, times_open, power_open = get_spectrogram(raw_open_avg)
freqs_closed, times_closed, power_closed = get_spectrogram(raw_closed_avg)

mask_open = (freqs_open >= 1) & (freqs_open <= 45)
mask_closed = (freqs_closed >= 1) & (freqs_closed <= 45)

vmin = min(power_open[mask_open].min(), power_closed[mask_closed].min())
vmax = max(power_open[mask_open].max(), power_closed[mask_closed].max())

fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    1, 2, figsize=(13, 4),
    constrained_layout=True
)

mesh = axes[0].pcolormesh(
    times_open, freqs_open[mask_open], power_open[mask_open, :],
    shading="auto", vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax
)
axes[0].set_title("Oz — Eyes Open")

axes[1].pcolormesh(
    times_closed, freqs_closed[mask_closed],
    power_closed[mask_closed, :],
    shading="auto", vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax
)
axes[1].set_title("Oz — Eyes Closed")

for ax in axes:
    ax.set_xlabel("Time (s)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency (Hz)")
    ax.set_ylim(1, 45)

cbar = fig.colorbar(mesh, ax=axes, location="right", pad=0.04)
cbar.set_label("Power spectral density (dB re 1 V²/Hz)")

plt.savefig("/content/EEG_Submission/oz_spectrograms.png", dpi=300)
plt.show()
